exchanges: hey, survived day one at brightwell lol
Congrats on making it through day one!
honestly so tired, they had me shadowing ppl for like 9 hours
That's a long stretch of shadowing, hope you can put your feet up tonight.
officially a dispatcher now, which is wild cause i cant even plan my own week
Ha, maybe keeping everyone else on schedule will rub off on your own week.
my sister came by w groceries, she lives out in calderbrook so it was a trek for her
That was really kind of her to make the drive.
made pasta tonight, nothin fancy
Simple pasta is hard to beat after a long day.
pickwick knocked a whole mug off the counter while i was cooking
Cats do love testing gravity, hope it wasn't a favourite mug.
dad's sciatica is acting up again so hes stuck on the couch
Oh no, I hope he gets some relief soon.
weather's been gross all week tbh
Grey weeks really drag, hopefully it clears up soon.
my sister in law keeps saying wrenfield is way quieter than the city lol, trying to get us to visit
A quiet weekend away could be nice if you can make it work.
tobin dragged me to orienteering on saturday, i got lost within 10 min which i think is the opposite of the point
Getting lost is practically a rite of passage, sounds like a fun day out.
jodie, my brothers wife, sent a pic of her tomato plants, theyre massive
Sounds like she's got a real green thumb.
priya from work swears by quillon for lunch, the sandwiches are apparently unreal
Sounds like a lunch spot worth trying soon.
my feet hurt so bad from these new shoes
New shoes can be brutal until they break in.
kind of bored tonight, might just go to bed early
An early night sounds like a good plan after this week.
slept like a rock, feeling human again
That's great, a good sleep fixes a lot.
the cat is a korat btw, ppl always think shes a russian blue
Easy mix-up, they do look a lot alike.
tobin's been binging ironvale nonstop, wont shut up about it
Sounds like he's completely hooked.
work tomorrow is a double, pray for me
Good luck, pack some good snacks.

Might be worth getting that checked before it gets worse.
my sister mara wants to do a family dinner next sunday at dads

thinking of bringing a pie or somethin

lol remind me never to drink coffee after 4
Noted, afternoon coffee is a sneaky sleep thief.
just set up the dehumidifier i bought, basement already smells better
That should make the basement a lot more pleasant.
ok gonna go watch something and pass out
Enjoy, and sleep well!
